amendment.rule: highest keyword-prompt recall subject to confusable-prompt FA <= 3/16 (N=3); ties -> higher threshold
amendment.reason: Validation set is tiny (25 kw / 16 confusable prompts): FA differences of 1-2 are not significant, and pure lexicographic FA-first collapsed recall to 48 %. The declared rule used adversarial confusables as a proxy for the architecture's criterion (FA/h on held-out ambient), which it does not measure. Amended BEFORE any held-out evaluation; held-out sets (ambient c002, overnight ambient, new sessions/speakers) remain untouched and are the test.
amendment.honesty_note: Both the declared outcome and the amendment are reported; the amendment is a post-hoc choice on validation data.
